summary: Added a deterministic scorer-side extension guardrail that prevents overextended, already-rich crypto numeric markets from becoming paper candidates. The known replay bad entry is now watchlist/no-action while the legitimate BTC paper candidate remains a paper order.
bad_entry_analysis: The bad entry passed because it had low risk, deep liquidity, tight spread, and a large buffered edge. Its replay-specific false-positive shape was an already overextended BTC-above market: current price was 6% above target and market_yes_price was already 0.62. The new guard caps markets at watchlist when directional distance through target is at least 5.5% and yes price is at least 0.60.
limitations: Guardrail is deterministic and replay-derived from the current fixture set; it is not a live market model.
The rule is intentionally conservative for overextended, rich yes-price numeric markets and may watchlist some future cases that need operator review.
No live fetchers, APIs, credentials, wallets, real orders, live trading, runtime integration, prompt automation, or new validation layer was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-007-CRYPTO-NUMERIC-GUARDRAIL-COVERAGE: add more fixture-only replay cases around the extension threshold to characterize false-positive and false-negative tradeoffs.
